pull.title: MINOR: Resilience improvements on leadership change
pull.body:
`ShareConsumeRequestManager` has complicated behaviour when leadership
or cluster  topology change. Additional testing and analysis has
suggested improvements  where the share consumer could get stuck in some
situations.

The specific fixes are:
- Replace the cached leader from metadata when metadata holds a strictly
newer epoch, so a
  refresh is useful even when the cached node is still in the cluster.
- Forget cached leaders for a node when a request to it cannot be
delivered, so the next
  poll re-seeds them from metadata and follows a leader change the dead
node cannot report.
- Request a metadata refresh when a partition error names no new leader,
when the topic is
  unknown, or when metadata refuses a redirect the cache accepted,
instead of waiting for
  the periodic refresh. Remove the dead top-level UNKNOWN_TOPIC_ID
refresh.
- Fail acknowledgements queued for a node which no longer has a share
session, rather than
  leaving them pending forever after the node disappears from the
cluster.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.1 <claude@anthropic.com>
